changes.description: Show me how ends on the scale Map shades the result with. The practitioner: "At the end shouldn't the goal be in summarization to render a shading corresponding to the resulting scale?" The last step shaded the two units by opacity alone, 95% against 76% of one green, with no key to read a total from. Now each unit takes its colour from Map's own classes of the totals, keyed below the drawing by range ("6", "7 to 8"). Houses a step sets aside are drawn without their labels, and House 6 sits above North, so its label stays inside the drawing and is not read as inside South.
